welcome_subheading: Please complete your clinical intake before seeing the doctor.
choose_interaction_mode: How would you like to continue?
id_method_title: How would you like to provide your Patient ID?
scanner_instruction: Hold your barcode or QR code in front of the camera.
keypad_placeholder: Enter your ID (letters, numbers, or combination)
keypad_invalid: Please enter a valid Patient ID.
not_found_title: We could not find this Patient ID.
not_found_desc: Let's create your new patient record.
continue_illness_prompt: Would you like to continue with your previous illness or start a new illness?
continue_with_this_illness_q: Would you like to continue with this illness?
no_records_found: No previous treatment records were found.
starting_symptoms_auto: Let's begin by understanding your current symptoms.
symptoms_title: Tell us what's bothering you today
symptoms_category_prompt: Select the problem that best describes why you are visiting.
symptoms_category_sub: You can select one or more problems that apply.
symptom_summary_desc: Please review your reported symptoms below before seeing the physician.
safety_alert_desc: Based on the reported symptoms or exposure, please notify the clinical triage desk or medical staff immediately.
select_at_least_one: Please select at least one problem or choose 'I don't know'.
voice_speak_prompt_id: Please choose whether you want to scan your ID or enter your ID number.
voice_speak_prompt_scan: Please hold your barcode or QR code in front of the camera.
voice_speak_prompt_keypad: Please enter your Patient ID on the keypad and press Enter.
voice_speak_prompt_lang: Please select your language and interaction mode.
voice_speak_prompt_confirm: We found your patient record. Please confirm if this is you.
voice_speak_prompt_register: We could not find this ID. Please enter your name, phone number, age, and gender to register.
voice_speak_prompt_reg_confirm: Please review and confirm your registration details.
voice_speak_prompt_history: We found previous medical records. Would you like to continue with the same illness or a new illness?
voice_speak_prompt_history_details: Here is your previous illness summary. Would you like to continue with this illness?
voice_speak_prompt_history_auto_skip: No previous medical records found. Let's begin understanding your symptoms.
voice_speak_prompt_symptoms: Please describe what symptoms or discomfort you are feeling.
voice_speak_prompt_category: What brings you here today? You can say fever, pain, cough, eye problem, injury, animal bite, or other problem.
voice_speak_prompt_docs: If you have prior prescriptions or lab reports, you can scan them now, or tap Continue.
voice_speak_prompt_completed: All done. Your clinical intake has been transmitted directly to your doctor. Please take a seat.
voice_unavailable: Voice interaction is currently unavailable on this device.
all_done_title: All Done — Please Take a Seat
all_done_desc: Your clinical intake has been transmitted directly to your doctor's consultation dashboard.
consent_subheading: As a first-time visitor, please review and accept our data sharing, voice processing, and clinical care policies.
consent_info_desc: I consent to MediKiosk collecting, storing, and sharing my personal details, clinical complaints, and health history with consulting doctors for medical care.
consent_voice_desc: I consent to the recording and AI-assisted processing of my voice answers and speech for symptom extraction and clinical documentation.
consent_rest_desc: I agree to hospital outpatient protocols, emergency triage screening rules, and doctor consultation terms.
voice_speak_prompt_consent: Welcome. As a first time patient, please review and accept our consent for information collection, voice recording, and hospital consultation to proceed.
scan_report_desc: Upload or scan previous prescriptions, lab reports, or discharge summaries
